title: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP Trichromatic
purpose: Hardware-level optical and sensor simulation for zero-artifact photorealism.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP BSI Trichromatic
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~50mm full-frame equivalent normal field of view
sensor_and_optics.lens: Schneider Kreuznach 80mm LS f/2.8 Blue Ring
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit raw tonal range with 15 stops of dynamic latitude
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Leaf shutter with 1/1600s high-speed flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Studio strobe, 1/1600s leaf shutter sync, ISO 50 base sensor sensitivity, 16-bit raw tonal range
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Key light with large parabolic modifier, deep shadows carved with black foam-core negative fill, single-axis specular catchlights

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface scattering without artificial blur or waxy specularities
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, micro-abrasions, uncompressed specular highlight falloff
High optical acutance and MTF contrast without digital edge halos or unsharp masking artifacts
depth_and_optics: Subtle optical falloff characteristic of large-sensor f/8 depth of field
Zero perspective distortion, clean rectilinear projection
Clean edge transitions driven purely by lighting and geometry, not artificial post-process depth slicing

execution_directive: Enforce true raw-capture fidelity from a 150MP digital back. Eliminate post-processed sharpening looks, synthetic smoothing, and non-physical lighting.
